query: UPDATE api_keys SET lookup_id = $1, secret_digest = $2, daily_cost_limit = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE daily_cost_limit END, monthly_cost_limit = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE monthly_cost_limit END, etag = $7, rotated_at = now() WHERE id = $8 AND etag = $9 AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
